personality_one_liner: An offline-first clinical command center with stone-clean iOS ergonomics, robust patient operation tracking, and zero-server Wi-Fi/Bluetooth sync.

spacing.rule: Generous iOS vertical padding with comfortable touch targets ≥44pt and safe-area margins.

do's: Use translucent blurred headers over scrolling patient lists
Apply glass cards on featured dashboard stat modules
dont's: Never blur input fields or dense inventory tables

screens.name: Auth / PIN Unlock
screens.purpose: Device-stored PIN or password verification for admin and staff access without cloud dependency.

states.empty: Set up your admin PIN to secure local records.

screens.layout: Centered clean card with masked 6-digit PIN dots, numeric keypad, and biometric prompt simulation.

screens.name: Dashboard / Statistics
screens.purpose: Overview of today's patient visits, repeat operation counts, low-stock alerts, and quick PDF export triggers.

states.empty: No clinical data recorded yet. Add your first patient visit.
states.error: Failed to load local database stats. Tap to retry.

screens.layout: ScrollView with top clinic branding header (editable logo/title), stat summary cards, low stock warning banner, and quick PDF export bar.

screens.name: Patient List & Visit Tracking
screens.purpose: Comprehensive patient roster with automatic duplicate detection (Name + MrNumber) marking repeat visits (2nd, 3rd time operated).

states.empty: No patients found. Tap + to register a patient visit.

screens.layout: Sticky search bar at top, filter chips (All / Repeat / New), patient cards showing operation count badges, and FAB to register visit.

screens.name: Inventory & Stock Management
screens.purpose: CRUD for clinic medical supplies, medicines, and equipment with automatic low-stock highlighting and PDF report export.

states.empty: Inventory is empty. Add items like surgical kits or medicines.
states.error: Could not retrieve inventory. Tap to refresh.

screens.layout: Segmented inventory view (All / Low Stock), item cards with stock status badges and quick edit/delete actions, floating add item button.

screens.name: Direct Device Sync (Offline Wi-Fi / Bluetooth)
screens.purpose: Allows multiple phones to sync data directly without online servers when an admin initiates admin-to-device peer sync.

states.empty: No nearby devices found. Ensure Wi-Fi/Bluetooth is active.
states.error: Sync interrupted. Check connection and retry.

screens.layout: Radar wave animation, admin host start button, connected peers list, and manual JSON export/import backup fallback.

screens.name: Clinic Settings & Customization
screens.purpose: Admin controls to set custom clinic title, upload/change logo, customize app color theme, and manage security PIN.

states.empty: Configure your clinic title and branding.

screens.layout: Form groups for Clinic Title, Logo URL upload, color palette selector, backup/restore data, and app version info.

instructions_to_main_agent: Build a fully offline-first React Native / Expo clinical management app for multi-phone deployment without any online server.
Implement local storage persistence (AsyncStorage / SQLite style local store) for patients, visits, repeat operation counts (Name + MrNumber matching), and inventory CRUD.
Support admin PIN/password login stored securely on the device.
Implement PDF export functionality for patient list, clinic statistics, and low-stock inventory, ensuring custom clinic title and uploaded logo appear on generated reports.
Allow full admin customization of clinic title, logo upload/edit, and app color theme.
Implement direct peer-to-peer sync simulation (Wi-Fi/Bluetooth direct sync where admin acts as sync host and other phones sync instantly offline).
Ensure all touch targets are ≥44pt, loading/empty/error states are fully handled on all data screens, and strict adherence to iOS-native clean design principles.
